description: This file contains helper functions for handling cell address conversions, extracting cell addresses, and worksheet extraction in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the LookupRef calculation namespace.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: Contains static utility methods for handling cell address conversions and worksheet extraction in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: convertR1C1
methods.description: Converts R1C1 notation to A1 notation based on provided parameters, modifying cell addresses accordingly.

methods.name: adjustSheetTitle
methods.description: Appends sheet title to cell reference if necessary and adjusts the cell address string.

methods.name: extractCellAddresses
methods.description: Extracts and resolves cell addresses from a string, handling named ranges, and converts between R1C1 and A1 notation.

methods.name: extractWorksheet
methods.description: Determines the worksheet from a cell address which might include the sheet name prefix.
